value.description: A cutting-edge helmet loaded with flashy gadgets — most of which are completely useless planetside. Fortunately, the targeting-assist pseudo-AI still works.
Part of the Alecto Hazard Carapace set, this helmet offers superior protection against extreme heat, cold, vacuum and radiation.
